sections.title: Saying what colour it is
sections.content: Colour words say what a thing is like, so they work like *meleg* and *finom*: no verb. *A póló piros.* (The T-shirt is red.) Five colours: *piros* (red), *kék* (blue), *fekete* (black), *fehér* (white) and *zöld* (green). To ask, use *milyen*: *Milyen a póló?* (What is the T-shirt like?) – *Piros.*
There is no *van* in these sentences: *A póló piros*, not *A póló van piros*. A short answer to *Milyen...?* is just the colour.
